name: Ruou Kim Son
summary: Kim Sơn’s local rượu, the liquor Ninh Bình names beside its goat and cơm cháy. It is a different drink from the Mường jar wine of Nho Quan.
seoTitle: Ruou Kim Son — the overview’s drink
seoDescription: Rượu Kim Sơn, the Kim Sơn liquor Ninh Bình names beside goat and cơm cháy.
